subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 5 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these updated third-party action SHAs for the CodeQL and credentialed container-publishing workflows after reviewing the upstream releases and exact-head workflow evidence?
rationale: The proposed changes are mechanically narrow, but they update executable third-party code in workflows that upload security results and handle registry credentials; this protected security boundary requires explicit maintainer risk acceptance.

options.title: Accept after workflow verification

options.title: Pause the dependency bump
